text:
maria-support: BrightWave (dedicated pool eu-west-2) opened a ticket: p95 generation latency jumped to ~1.2s and occasional 503s since ~03:40 UTC. They think it correlates with other tenants on same node. Sample request_ids: rq_83f7, rq_83f9. Attaching small log snippet below.

ajay-engr: Can you paste the request log lines? Any 429s or quota throttles showing up?

maria-support: No 429s seen on their side. We're seeing inference timeouts and 503s in runtime. Snippet: ```2026-03-15T03:41:12Z rq_83f7 model=redwood-2 call_latency=1204ms status=503 module=runtime```

kevin-sre: Kicking off host-level probe against host-74 (eu-west-2a). Running nvtop + nvidia-smi dmon. Quick heads-up: memory-bandwidth counters spike when the tail hits. One MIG slice briefly saturates BW.

sophia-ops: Autoscaler didn't trigger any scale events during that window — pool stayed at nominal capacity. Any recent kernel/driver churn in the deploy window?

len-ml: We applied a host kernel + nv driver update last night (nv-driver v5.2.1) to improve PCI fairness. Possible regression in arbitration across MIG slices.

maria-support: Customer log shows repeated micro-bursts: ```[2026-03-15 03:41:12] slice-2 bw=98% lat=1.1s``` They see spikes roughly every ~20s.

ajay-engr: Looking at host counters: L3 cache miss ratio high on slice-2, and KV cache eviction counts spike concurrently. Looks like cross-slice eviction of KV entries — suspicious. Can we repro with a synthetic noisy sibling?

kevin-sre: Launched a stress job on sibling slice: `tools/bench/stress_mig --pattern wave --duration 10m` (host-74, slice-3). Observed matching p95 spikes on tenant slice (BrightWave). Repro confirmed.

deploy-bot: probe-runner: job 8923 started on host-74 :rocket:

sophia-ops: Immediate mitigation proposal: live-migrate BrightWave off host-74 to an isolated host and open maintenance window for the node. Can someone start the migration?

maria-support: Informed customer, they approved migration. Scheduling Live-migrate -> host-81. Also asked for full request traces and container logs.

len-ml: Short-term runtime mitigations to consider: raise noisy-neighbor detection threshold to 60% (spare capacity) and enable `sibling-cooldown` to avoid co-scheduling heavy micro-bursting workloads. Also add KV-cache pinning guard to reduce cross-MIG evictions.

ajay-engr: I'll open a JIRA (INF-4238) to track KV pinning change + vendor driver escalation. Filing a support case with GPU vendor for potential arbitration regression in nv-driver v5.2.1.

nina-ecs: Migration initiated — live-migrate container rq_83f7 -> host-81 (container move id cm_774). ETA ~2m.

maria-support: Migration finished. Customer reports p95 back to baseline (~230ms) and no further 503s. They asked to be notified about the driver follow-up. Closing ticket pending follow-up JIRA. :thumbsup:

kevin-sre: Follow-ups: 1) Keep host-74 quarantined until driver vendor replies, 2) roll KV-cache guard in canary tomorrow, 3) notify customers migrated during window.

ajay-engr: Note: repro workflow and stress script saved under `infra/diag/stress_mig/wave-pattern/README.md` for future triage.

maria-support: Thanks team — marking as resolved in support tracker. If vendor confirms regression we'll schedule patch rollback or alternate driver.
